classification.difficultyReason: Account for several population changes and reverse the net change to find the unknown number born.

content.prompt: The population of an ant colony was 14 000 at the start of January. By the end of the month, 256 ants had died, 89 ants had moved into the colony and 123 ants had moved out. The population at the end of January was 14 298. How many ants were born between the start and the end of the month?

answer.worked:
Without births, the population would have been
$$\begin{align*}14\,000-256+89-123&=13\,710.\end{align*}$$
The number born was
$$\begin{align*}14\,298-13\,710&=588.\end{align*}$$
Therefore, 588 ants were born.
